blocks.text: CEBU, Philippines, 26th October 2026 – SM J Mall, Japanese-inspired destination in Mandaue City, continues to redefine the mall experience for Cebuanos by bringing together dining, lifestyle, and leisure in one vibrant space. As Cebu’s most-loved mall destination, it offers maxed-out experiences for families, friends, food enthusiasts, and lifestyle seekers looking for new ways to spend time together. More than a place to shop, SM J Mall is where everyday visits become opportunities to discover, connect, and create lasting memories. From its Food Hall and diverse dining concepts to the Izakaya Terrace and various art installations, SM J Mall gives visitors […]...
